[[File:AmadiciaFlag.png|right|300px]]The '''Guardians of the Gate''' were a permanent formation of the national army of [[Amadicia]], serving mainly as a bodyguard to the monarch of the nation.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Amadicia|Amadicia}}{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 28: The military of the land}}

==Purpose and Restrictions==
They are formed as part of the army loyal to the monarch of Amadicia, also called "Guardian of the Southern Gate". The last of these was [[Ailron Rovere Lukan]]. The influence and large numbers of the [[Children of the Light]] meant that their number was never allowed to be more than around a thousand men, where the total number of standing forces, border guards and and the like never numbered more than three to four thousand, except in times of war.{{ref||Amadicia}}

==Uniform==
They were dressed in mail and conical steel caps. They wear blue cloaks bearing the Star and Thistle.{{ref/book|5|13}}

==Activities and Fate==
[[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and others see them in large numbers in [[Sienda]] on their journey back from [[Tanchico]].{{ref/book|5|13}}

[[Abdel Omerna]] reports to [[Pedron Niall]] that Ailron's men (the Guardians) are at the point of scattering the [[Dragonsworn]], but Niall thinks the reason more that the Dragonsworn simply stopped advancing for their own reasons.{{ref/book|6|9}}

Most of the Guardians were killed, made [[Da'covale]] or became fugitives after the [[Battle of Jeramel]], also known as Ailron's Disaster. The King himself was also killed.{{ref||Amadicia}}
